assumptions.tax_treatment: STR losses assumed non-passive (avg stay <=7d + material participation)
assumptions.breakeven_definition: Three tests are reported. purchase_year = year-1 after-tax operating cash flow (financed) >= $0, i.e. break-even net of tax WITH the 100% bonus-depreciation benefit (nearly always true — the shield swamps the operating loss). sustained = stabilized (yr 2+, no depreciation) after-tax cash flow (financed) >= $0 (the strict self-funding test). operating_allcash = stabilized after-tax cash flow >= $0 unlevered. break_even_down_pct = equity fraction needed to self-fund annually; horizon_years = years the one-time yr-1 tax windfall keeps the cumulative position non-negative.
